title: Build a Reactive Effect
short_description: Build a reduced model that connects reactive properties with their dependent effects.
description: Vue's reactivity system connects each object and property with the effects that read it.
Implement pedagogical versions of effect, track, trigger, and reactive to build that graph and use it automatically through a Proxy.
instructions: Make effect(fn) run fn while its runner is the active effect, and clear it afterwards.
Make track(target, key) connect the active effect to the correct property through a WeakMap, Map, and Set.
Make trigger(target, key) re-run only the effects registered for that property.
Make reactive(target) use a Proxy's get and set traps to call track and trigger.
Keep resetReactivity working so each test starts with an empty graph.

hints.title: The active effect
hints.body: Create a `runner`, assign it to `activeEffect`, and execute `fn` inside `try`. Use `finally` to clear the active effect.

hints.title: Three graph levels
hints.body: Use `targetMap.get(target)` to obtain the property `Map`, then `dependenciesMap.get(key)` to obtain the effect `Set`. Create each level when it does not exist yet.

hints.title: Selective notification
hints.body: In `trigger`, find the `Set` with the same `target` and `key`. Iterate over a copy with `new Set(effects)` to keep the iteration stable.

hints.title: Automate with Proxy
hints.body: The `get` trap should call `track(object, key)` before returning the property. The `set` trap should assign the value, call `trigger(object, key)`, and return `true`.
